confirmedTarget: Restaurant billing from a tightly gathered bundle of skewer blunt end faces, viewed toward the ends.
findings: Five permissively available real photos were downloaded and visually inspected. Two are side-view bamboo skewers; three show pointed toothpick tips. All are excluded from the confirmed blunt-end counting validation set.
No synthetic/generated images were used as counting-accuracy evidence.
No item count was inferred from a retail package title, density, or obscured sticks.

datasetResearch.accessObservation: Public dataset metadata and download-format links were readable. Browse and download pages returned only JavaScript-dependent shell text to the web reader. In-app browser was unavailable; no signup/login or authentication bypass attempted. The presence of a download link does not prove anonymous export is available.
datasetResearch.evaluationCaution: Versions list augmentations; do not equate generated/augmented image totals with independent real scenes or reuse overlapping originals across training and acceptance.

nextEvidenceNeeded: Actual representative restaurant bundle photographs with a separately counted total and visible blunt ends; include round and flat heads, clean and used sticks, controlled and ordinary lighting, small and large bundles. Freeze original images and manual point annotations before comparing model changes.
